# Setup
```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pals)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(GGally)


root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))
data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, 'ExternalData/')
results.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/")
processed.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/")


gbm.only <- F

if (gbm.only) {
  sample.id <- "GBM_samples"
} else {
  sample.id <- "all_postmortem_samples"
}


set.seed(123)
```



# General settings
```{r}
cd45.neg.ref.use  <- "velmeshev2019"
denoise <- T
filter <- F
cellbender <- F
batch.correction <- "None"


denoise.vars.to.regress <- c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")

if (denoise) {
  denoise.label <- paste0(denoise.vars.to.regress, collapse = "_")
} else {
  denoise.label <- "FALSE"
}


output.dir <- paste0("all_postmortem_samples", "_cellbender.", cellbender, "_denoise.", denoise.label, "_filter.", filter, "_batch.correction.", batch.correction, "/")


if (gbm.only) {
  oligo.dir <- paste0(results.dir, output.dir, 'oligodendrocytes/', 'gbm/')
  dir.create(oligo.dir)
} else {
  oligo.dir <- paste0(results.dir, output.dir, 'oligodendrocytes/')
}


seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", output.dir, "seurat_objects/", "all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
seurat.obj$seurat_clusters.original <- seurat.obj$seurat_clusters

data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = c("BCAS1", "ASPA", "FGFR1", "FGFR2", "FGF1", "FGF2", "MBP", "MOG", "ENPP6", "STAT1", "CCL5", "CX3CR1", "IFNGR1", "IFNGR2",
                                       "OLIG2", "PDGFRA", "CSPG4", "SOX10"))
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, data)

if (gbm.only) {
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = patient %in% c("P1", "P2"))
}

seurat.obj.original <- seurat.obj
```



# Standard Seurat pipeline
```{r}
predictions.df <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Classifier/", "output/", "my_data_predictions.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, predictions.df)
seurat.obj$celltype.final <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(as.logical(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]]), row[["labels_initial"]], row[["predicted.annotation_l2"]]))

seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (celltype.final == "Oligodendrocytes") | (celltype.final == "Glial" & predicted.annotation_l2 == "Oligodendrocytes"))


seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, oligo.gene.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, gene.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, myelination.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, gene.signatures.gsea) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, oligo.jakel2019.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, fgf.gene.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, fgfr.gene.signatures) 
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, mikolajewicz.signatures) 


data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars = c("BCAS1", "ENPP6", "ASPA", "MOG", "MBP", "OPALIN", "PDGFRA", "PSMB8", "CDKN1A", "SERPINA3", "FGFR1", "FGFR2"))
seurat.obj.oligo <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.oligo, data)


seurat.obj.oligo <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj.oligo)
seurat.obj.oligo <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.oligo)

if (denoise) {
  seurat.obj.oligo <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
} else {
  seurat.obj.oligo <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.oligo)
}


set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.oligo <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.oligo, approx=T, seed.use = 42)

p <- ElbowPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, ndims=50)

if (gbm.only) {
  pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_elbowplot_oligodendrocyte_clusters_gbm.only.pdf"), height=6, width=8)
} else {
  pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_elbowplot_oligodendrocyte_clusters.pdf"), height=6, width=8)
}
print(p)
dev.off()


if (gbm.only) {
  dims.use.oligo <- 5
} else {
  dims.use.oligo <- 6
}

res.use.oligo <- 0.5
seurat.obj.oligo <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj.oligo, dims = 1:dims.use.oligo, nn.method = "rann")
seurat.obj.oligo <- FindClusters(seurat.obj.oligo, resolution = res.use.oligo, cluster.name = "oligodendrocyte_clusters", random.seed = 0)
seurat.obj.oligo$oligodendrocyte_clusters <- as.character(seurat.obj.oligo$oligodendrocyte_clusters)
seurat.obj.oligo <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.oligo, dims = 1:dims.use.oligo, n.neighbors=30, seed.use=42, min.dist = 0.3)


# UMAP
p.clusters.original <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "seurat_clusters.original", label=T, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Cluster original") + NoAxes()
p.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "oligodendrocyte_clusters", label=T, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Cluster") + NoAxes()
p.patient <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "patient", label=F, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Donor") + NoAxes()

seurat.obj.oligo$location <- factor(seurat.obj.oligo$location, levels = sample.locations)

p.location <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "location", label=F, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Location") + sample.location.color.scale + NoAxes()
p.location.pca <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "location", label=F, shuffle=T, reduction = "pca", dims=1:2) + ggtitle("Location") + sample.location.color.scale


# plot PC 2 (varies by location)
pca_embeddings <- Embeddings(seurat.obj.oligo, reduction = "pca")
df <- data.frame(PC2 = pca_embeddings[, "PC_2"], location = seurat.obj.oligo$location)
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PC2, color = location)) +
  geom_freqpoly(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 50, size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  sample.location.color.scale
pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_pca_by_location.pdf"), width=7, height=5)
print(p)
dev.off()


seurat.obj.oligo$tumor.adjacent <- sapply(seurat.obj.oligo$sample.id, function(x) x %ni% c(healthy.sections, "P2 S8"))
p.adjacent <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "tumor.adjacent", label = F, shuffle = T) + ggtitle("Tumor-adjcent") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))  + NoAxes()
p.sample <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "sample.id", label=F, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Sample ID") + sample.ids.color.scale + NoAxes()

p.sample.desc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "sample.desc", label=F, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Sample description") + sample.descs.color.scale + NoAxes()
p.sample.desc.pca <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "sample.desc", label=F, shuffle=T, reduction = "pca", dims=1:2) + ggtitle("Sample description") + sample.descs.color.scale


p.method <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "method", label=F, shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Method") + NoAxes()
p.phase <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "Phase", shuffle=T) + ggtitle("Predicted Cell Cycle Phase") + NoAxes()
p.low.quality.qc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "low.quality.by.qc", order=T) + ggtitle("Low-quality") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red")) + NoAxes()
p.high.postmortem.noise <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "high.postmortem.noise", order=T) + ggtitle("High postmortem noise") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red")) + NoAxes()
p.olig2 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("OLIG2"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.sox10 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("SOX10"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.mog <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("MOG"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.mbp <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("MBP"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.pdfgra <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("PDGFRA"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.bcas1 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("BCAS1"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.aspa <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("ASPA"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.fgf1 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("FGF1"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.fgf2 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("FGF2"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.fgfr1 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("FGFR1"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.fgfr2 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("FGFR2"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.b2m <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("B2M"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.hla.a <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("HLA-A"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.cd44 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("CD44"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.vegfa <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("VEGFA"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.opalin <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("OPALIN"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.enpp6 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("ENPP6"), order=T) + NoAxes()

p.percent.mt <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("percent.mt"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.ncount.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("nCount_RNA"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.nfeature.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.postmortem.noise <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("postmortem.signature"), order=T) + ggtitle("Postmortem noise") + NoAxes()
p.heat.shock <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("heat.shock.signature"), order=T) + ggtitle("Heat shock") + NoAxes()
p.oligo.like <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("reactive.oligo.general"), order=T) + ggtitle("Reactive oligo signature\n(general)") + NoAxes()
p.reactive.oligo.non.tumor <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("reactive.oligo.non.tumor"), order=T) + ggtitle("Reactive oligo signature\n(non-tumor)") + NoAxes()
p.reactive.oligo.general <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c("reactive.oligo.specific"), order=T) + ggtitle("Reactive oligo signature\n(oligo-specific)") + NoAxes()
 
p <- p.clusters.original + p.clusters + p.patient + p.location + p.location.pca + p.adjacent + p.sample + p.sample.desc + p.sample.desc.pca + p.method + 
  p.phase + p.low.quality.qc + p.high.postmortem.noise +
  p.olig2 + p.sox10 + p.mog + p.mbp + p.pdfgra + p.bcas1 + p.aspa + p.opalin + p.enpp6 + p.fgf1 + p.fgf2 + p.fgfr1 + p.fgfr2 + p.b2m + p.hla.a + p.cd44 + p.vegfa +
  p.percent.mt + p.ncount.rna + p.nfeature.rna + p.postmortem.noise + p.heat.shock + p.oligo.like + p.reactive.oligo.non.tumor + p.reactive.oligo.general
  
pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_UMAP.pdf"), width=36, height=20)
print(p)
dev.off()




oligo.genes.of.interest <- c("OLIG2", "SOX10", "MOG", "MBP", "PDGFRA", "BCAS1", "ASPA", "OPALIN", "ENPP6", "FGF1", "FGF2", "FGFR1", "FGFR2", "B2M", "HLA-A", "CD44", "VEGFA")
oligo.vars.of.interest <- c("percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "apoptosis.signature", "reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific", oligo.genes.of.interest)


# by oligo seurat cluster, QC and myelin genes per sample
oligo.clusters.ordered <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(oligodendrocyte_clusters) %>%
  summarize(oligo.like = mean(reactive.oligo.general)) %>%
  arrange(desc(oligo.like)) %>%
  pull(oligodendrocyte_clusters)
seurat.obj.oligo$oligodendrocyte_clusters <- factor(seurat.obj.oligo$oligodendrocyte_clusters, levels = oligo.clusters.ordered)
p <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "oligodendrocyte_clusters", features = oligo.vars.of.interest, stack = T, flip = T) + stat_summary(fun.y = median, geom='point', size = 20, colour = "black", shape = 95) + NoLegend()
pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_myelin.genes.by.oligodendrocyte_clusters.pdf"), width=12, height=20)
print(p)
dev.off()


# markers by cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "seurat_clusters", min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, only.pos = F)
write.table(markers, paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_markers_by_seurat_clusters.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=T)

markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "oligodendrocyte_clusters", min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, only.pos = F)
write.table(markers, paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_markers_by_oligodendrocyte_clusters.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=T)


if (gbm.only) {
  write.table(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '_oligodendrocytes_gbm.only.tsv'), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T)
} else {
  write.table(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '_oligodendrocytes.tsv'), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T)
}




#### individual gene expression for reactive oligo signature
for (sig in c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific")) {
  print(sig)
  
  p <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = c(oligo.gene.signatures[[sig]][1:50], "OLIG2", "SOX10", "MBP", "PLP1", "MOG"), order = T)
  pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "by_gene/", sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes_", sig, "_featureplot.pdf"), width=24, height=48)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  # vlnplot by sample and patient
  oligo.features <- c(oligo.gene.signatures[[sig]][1:50], "OLIG2", "SOX10", "MBP", "PLP1", "MOG") 
  p1 <- VlnPlot(subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = patient == "P1"), group.by = "sample.desc.method", features = oligo.features, stack = T, flip = T) + NoLegend()
  p2 <- VlnPlot(subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = patient == "P2"), group.by = "sample.desc.method", features = oligo.features, stack = T, flip = T) + NoLegend()
  
  if (gbm.only) {
    p <- p1 + p2
    pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "by_gene/", sample.id, "_", sig, "_vlnplot.pdf"), width=12, height=16)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    p4 <- VlnPlot(subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = patient == "P4"), group.by = "sample.desc.method", features = oligo.features, stack = T, flip = T) + NoLegend()
    p <- p1 + p2 + p4
    pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "by_gene/", sample.id, "_", sig, "_vlnplot.pdf"), width=18, height=16)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
}


saveRDS(seurat.obj.oligo, paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes.RDS"))
```

# OPCs
```{r}
dir.create(paste0(oligo.dir, "opcs/"))
dir.create(paste0(oligo.dir, "opcs/qc/"))

seurat.obj.opc <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = predicted.annotation_l2 == "OPC")
seurat.obj.opc <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.opc, oligo.jakel2019.signatures)
seurat.obj.opc <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.opc, oligo.gene.signatures) 
seurat.obj.opc <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.opc, gene.signatures) 


seurat.obj.opc <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.opc)

if (denoise) {
  seurat.obj.opc <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.opc, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
} else {
  seurat.obj.opc <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.opc)
}

set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.opc <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.opc)

p <- ElbowPlot(seurat.obj.opc, ndims = 50)
pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "opcs/", "qc/", "elbowplot.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
print(p)
dev.off()


seurat.obj.opc <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj.opc)
seurat.obj.opc <- FindClusters(seurat.obj.opc, resolution = 0.8, cluster.name = "opc_clusters")
seurat.obj.opc <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.opc, dims = 1:10)

p.sample.desc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.opc, group.by = "sample.desc") + sample.descs.color.scale + NoAxes()
p.sample <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.opc, group.by = "sample.id") + sample.ids.color.scale + NoAxes()
p.clusters.original <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.opc, group.by = "seurat_clusters.original", label = T) + NoAxes()
p.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.opc, group.by = "opc_clusters", label = T) + NoAxes()
p.OPCs <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("OPCs"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.COPs <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("COPs"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.imOLG <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("imOLG"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.Oligo1 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("Oligo1"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.Oligo2 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("Oligo2"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.Oligo3 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("Oligo3"), order=T) + NoAxes()
p.Oligo4 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.opc, features = c("Oligo4"), order=T) + NoAxes()
```

```{r}

for (core.only in c(T, F)) {
  
  if (core.only) {
    save.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Misc/", "FGF_FGFR/", "my_data_core_only/")
  } else {
    save.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Misc/", "FGF_FGFR/", "my_data/")
  }
  
  dir.create(save.dir)
  
  seurat.obj.oligo <- readRDS(paste0(oligo.dir, sample.id, "_oligodendrocytes.RDS"))
  seurat.obj.oligo$`Reactive oligo sig` <- seurat.obj.oligo$reactive.oligo.general
  #seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = method == "FACS")
  
  if (core.only) {
    seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = location == "Core")
    
    # subcluster core
    seurat.obj.oligo <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj.oligo)
    seurat.obj.oligo <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.oligo)
    
    if (denoise) {
      seurat.obj.oligo <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
    } else {
      seurat.obj.oligo <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.oligo)
    }
    
    set.seed(123)
    seurat.obj.oligo <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.oligo)
    ElbowPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, ndims = 50)
    n.dims.use <- 20
    seurat.obj.oligo <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj.oligo, dims = 1:n.dims.use)
    seurat.obj.oligo <- FindClusters(seurat.obj.oligo, resolution = 1.2)
    seurat.obj.oligo <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.oligo, dims = 1:n.dims.use)
  }
  
  # seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, fgf.gene.signatures)
  # seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, oligo.gene.signatures)
  # seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, mikolajewicz.signatures)
  # seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, myelination.signatures)
  
  
  
  
  vars.of.interest <- c("reactive.oligo.general", "IFN_DAO", "DAO1", "DAO2", "O2.Reactive.1", "O5.Reactive.II", "O7.Stress", "O3.Cycling", "acute.demyelination", "acute.de.re.myelination", "MBP", "BCAS1", "PDGFRA", "PSMB8", "SERPINA3", "CDKN1A", "FGFR1", "FGFR2") # "ASPA", 
  
  setdiff(vars.of.interest, colnames(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data))
  
  
  # 1. Custom function for upper triangle: Spearman Rho + Raw P-Value
  my_spearman <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
    # Safely extract variable names as strings using rlang (comes with ggplot2)
    x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
    y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
    
    # Calculate Spearman correlation and p-value
    test <- cor.test(data[[x_name]], data[[y_name]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    
    rho <- round(test$estimate, 3)
    p_val <- test$p.value
    
    # Format p-value: use scientific notation if it's highly significant
    p_text <- format.p.value(p_val)
    
    lbl <- paste0("rho = ", rho, "\n", p_text)
    
    # Find midpoint of data for text placement
    x_mid <- mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE))
    y_mid <- mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
      annotate("text", x = x_mid, y = y_mid, label = lbl, size = 4) +
      theme_void()
  }
  
  # 2. Custom function for lower triangle (line of best fit only)
  my_smooth <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
    ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
      geom_smooth(method = "auto", color = "blue", ...)
  }
  
  # 3. Create the ggpairs plot using your Seurat metadata
  p <- ggpairs(
    seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data[vars.of.interest],
    lower = list(continuous = my_smooth),
    upper = list(continuous = my_spearman)
  ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  # 4. Save to PDF
  pdf(paste0(save.dir, "oligos_signature_correlations.pdf"), width = 20, height = 20)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  
  # main signatures
  vars.of.interest.subset <- c("Reactive oligo sig", "IFN_DAO", "DAO1", "DAO2")
  p <- ggpairs(
    seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data[vars.of.interest.subset],
    lower = list(continuous = my_smooth),
    upper = list(continuous = my_spearman)
  ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  if (core.only) {
    pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "Supplemental/", "oligos_signature_correlations_tumor.core.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 4/", "Supplemental/", "oligos_signature_correlations.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  
  
  comparisons.use <- list(c("Distal Inf.", "Distal"), c("Edge", "Distal"), c("Brainstem", "Distal"), c("Core", "Distal"))
  
  
  if (!core.only) {
    for (y in c("IFN_DAO", "DAO1", "DAO2")) {
      do.boxplot(data = seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, 
                 x.variable = "location",
                 y.variable = "IFN_DAO",
                 output.filepath = paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "Supplemental/", "oligodendrocytes_location_vs_", y, ".pdf"),
                 ylab.label = paste0(y, "\nin oligodendrocytes"),
                 comparisons = comparisons.use,
                 boxplot.fill.variable = "location",
                 fill.scale = sample.location.fill.scale,
                 image.width = 10, 
                 image.height = 8,
                 vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress,
                 ggtitle.label = y,
                 alternative = "greater",
                 y.adjust = -0.2)
    }
  }
  
  
  if (core.only) {
    p <- DotPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = vars.of.interest.subset, 
               group.by = "seurat_clusters", scale = T)
  
    # Clip avg.exp.scaled to q1–q99 per feature
    p$data <- p$data %>%
      group_by(features.plot) %>%
      mutate(avg.exp.scaled = {
        q_low  <- quantile(avg.exp.scaled, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
        q_high <- quantile(avg.exp.scaled, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
        pmin(pmax(avg.exp.scaled, q_low), q_high)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    p <- p + scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
    pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "Supplemental/", "dotplot_seurat.clusters_vs_oligo.signatures_tumor.core.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  
  }
  
  
  
  p1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "seurat_clusters", shuffle = T, label = T) + umap.axes
  p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "location", shuffle = T) + sample.location.color.scale + umap.axes + ggtitle("Location")
  
  
  
  if (core.only) {
    p <- p1
  } else {
    p <- p2
  }
  
  seurat.obj.oligo$`Reactive oligo sig` <- seurat.obj.oligo$reactive.oligo.general
  for (f in c("Reactive oligo sig", "IFN_DAO", "DAO1", "DAO2")) {
    feature_data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars = f)[[1]]
    
    min_val <- quantile(feature_data, 0.01)
    max_val <- quantile(feature_data, 0.99)
    
    p.f <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = f, order = TRUE) + 
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")),
        limits = c(min_val, max_val),
        oob = scales::squish
      ) + umap.axes
    p <- p + p.f
  }
  pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "Supplemental/", "my_data_fgf_signatures_featureplot_1_to_99_percentile_core.only=", core.only, ".pdf"), width = 24, height = 10)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  p <- p1 + p2
  for (f in vars.of.interest) {
    feature_data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars = f)[[1]]
  
    p.f <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = f, order = TRUE) + 
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")),
      )
    p <- p + p.f
  }
  pdf(paste0(save.dir, "fgf_signatures_featureplot.pdf"), width = 24, height = 18)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  p <- p1 + p2
  for (f in vars.of.interest) {
    feature_data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.oligo, vars = f)[[1]]
    
    min_val <- quantile(feature_data, 0.01)
    max_val <- quantile(feature_data, 0.99)
    
    p.f <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = f, order = TRUE) + 
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")),
        limits = c(min_val, max_val),
        oob = scales::squish
      )
    p <- p + p.f
  }
  pdf(paste0(save.dir, "fgf_signatures_featureplot_1_to_99_percentile.pdf"), width = 24, height = 18)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  # plot by group
  seurat.obj.oligo$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj.oligo$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)
  seurat.obj.oligo$sample.desc.method <- factor(seurat.obj.oligo$sample.desc.method, levels = sample.descs.by.method)
  
  for (group.by.use in c("seurat_clusters", "location", "sample.desc.method")) {
    p <- DotPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = vars.of.interest, group.by = group.by.use, scale = F) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
    pdf(paste0(save.dir, "fgf_signatures_dotplot_group.by=", group.by.use, ".pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
    p <- DotPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, features = vars.of.interest, group.by = group.by.use, scale = T) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
    pdf(paste0(save.dir, "fgf_signatures_dotplot_group.by=", group.by.use, "_scaled.pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(forcats)

vars.of.interest <- c("acute.demyelination", "acute.de.re.myelination", "reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific", 
                      "FGFR1", "FGFR2", "ASPA", "BCAS1", "MBP", "FGF1", "FGF2", "interferon.signature", "interferon.alpha.signature", "interferon.gamma.signature", 
                      "inflammatory.signature", "apoptosis.signature", "hypoxia.signature", "percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", 
                      "postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.glial", "STAT1", "CCL5", "CX3CR1", "IFNGR1", "IFNGR2")
for (y in vars.of.interest) {
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination",
    TRUE ~ y
  )
  
  # 1. Calculate the mean (or median) for each group to find the "highest"
  # We use .data[[y]] to handle the dynamic variable name
  group_means <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>%
    group_by(oligo.annotation) %>%
    summarise(avg = mean(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg))
  
  # 2. Extract the name of the highest group
  highest_group <- as.character(group_means$oligo.annotation[1])
  
  # 3. Reorder the factor levels in the dataframe so the highest is first (left)
  seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data$oligo.annotation <- factor(
    seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data$oligo.annotation, 
    levels = group_means$oligo.annotation
  )
  
  # 4. Plot with the dynamic reference group
  p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, aes(oligo.annotation, .data[[y]])) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      # Set ref.group to the highest_group variable we just calculated
      stat_compare_means(
          ref.group = highest_group, 
          method.args = list(alternative = "less")
      ) +
      stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "red") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      xlab("Oligodendrocyte") +
      ylab(y.title)
  
  # Save the plot
  pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "by_oligo_group/", "group_signatures/", "oligo_group_vs_", y, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()

}
```
